settings.about_text: Premium eggless cake crafted with fresh ingredients and luxurious presentation. Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries and all special celebrations.

settings.a: Yes — every cake we bake is 100% eggless, with no compromise on taste or texture. All our products are FSSAI approved.
We deliver across Meerut and selected nearby areas. Use Check Delivery Availability to confirm your location.

settings.q: How can I place a custom order?
settings.a: Tap WhatsApp Customization to chat with us directly. Share your design, flavour and date — we'll handle the rest.

settings.q: What is the shelf life of the cake?
settings.a: Best enjoyed within 24 hours. Refrigerate on arrival and bring to room temperature 15–20 minutes before serving.
